name: RecoveryBoot
description: FreeInk boot-time recovery hatch for BookPoint OS on Xteink X4 Pro (ESP32-S3). Held at reset, the Right hardware button (GPIO 7) repoints otadata at OTA slot 0 and reboots into the recovery / 'escape hatch' firmware. Call recovery::checkBootCombo() as the first line of setup(). Self-contained otadata switch (no esp_image_verify, so it accepts patched Xteink images) with GPIO 7 debouncing. No-op unless the button is held, slot 0 holds a valid app image (0xE9), and you're not already running from slot 0.
keywords: recovery, ota, bootloader, otadata, escape-hatch, xteink
